items.briefing:
Australian small businesses are being increasingly targeted by AI-generated scams that are more convincing and personalised than ever before. Separately, the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) has flagged that attackers are actively exploiting vulnerabilities in TeamCity servers — software used by some development and IT teams — urging organisations to apply available patches immediately.

These threats highlight the importance of keeping all software up to date, particularly tools exposed to the internet. **Practical tip:** If your organisation uses TeamCity, check with your IT team today to confirm it has been patched and is not publicly accessible without proper security controls.

featured.title: AI fuels targeted scams against Australian small firms
featured.summary: Targeted fraud is inflicting bigger losses on small firms as AI helps criminals forge convincing invoices and impersonations in Australia.
